archetype: Industrial Minimalist (Swiss & High-Contrast mixed with Neon trigger)

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Heavy use of whitespace to separate sections, offset by dense data clusters. Pure black backgrounds with 1px solid borders.
spacing_and_layout.borders: 1px solid #222222, no border radius rounding larger than 8px (rounded-lg). Many elements can be rounded-none for a sharper industrial look.
spacing_and_layout.shadows: Zero traditional drop shadows. Use 1px borders for separation. For 'glow' effects (Top 3 winners), use drop-shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(16,185,129,0.3)].

navigation.mobile: Persistent Bottom Navigation Bar with haptic feedback (using standard click states). Minimalist monochromatic icons (lucide-react). Pure black background with top border #222222.
navigation.desktop: Slim Sidebar (w-64 or w-20 collapsed) with monochromatic icons. Border right #222222.

buttons.primary: bg-[#10B981] text-black font-bold uppercase tracking-wide hover:bg-[#059669] transition-colors rounded-md px-6 py-3
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#222222] text-white hover:border-[#10B981] hover:text-[#10B981] transition-colors rounded-md px-6 py-3

cards.winner_card: bg-transparent border border-[#10B981] rounded-lg overflow-hidden relative shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(16,185,129,0.15)]

forms.inputs: bg-[#09090B] border border-[#222222] rounded-md text-white px-4 py-3 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#10B981] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#10B981] transition-all
forms.labels: text-xs tracking-widest uppercase text-[#A1A1AA] mb-2 block

animations_and_interactions.hover_states: Crisp, fast transitions (150ms). Borders lighting up to Emerald Green.
animations_and_interactions.active_states: Scale down slightly (scale-95) for haptic-like feel on mobile.
animations_and_interactions.page_transitions: Subtle fade-in (opacity 0 to 1). No heavy sliding.
animations_and_interactions.accessibility: Focus rings must be #10B981. Text contrast is AA compliant.

avatar_placeholder.description: Industrial worker portrait dark, used for Storekeeper User Verification and Leaderboard avatars.

prize_1.description: Premium black electric scooter, used in the Top 3 Winners Monthly Prize grid.

prize_2.description: Luxury smart watch on dark background, used in the Top 3 Winners Monthly Prize grid.

map_placeholder.description: Google maps navigation screen, used as a placeholder in the Storekeeper 'Current Store' view.

portal_1_user.home_balance: Must use 'numbers' typography hierarchy, massive scale (text-6xl or larger), crisp #FFFFFF against pure black.
portal_1_user.leaderboard: List items must be sparse. Top 3 rows receive 'winner_card' styling with a distinct emerald green glow.

portal_2_storekeeper.search_lookup: Massive input field, auto-focus on load, instant mock verification showing the 'avatar_placeholder'.
portal_2_storekeeper.transaction_form: Minimalist fields. [Bill Amount] should feel like a calculator input. [Mill Name Selection] uses Shadcn Select.

portal_3_admin.approval_dashboard: Data-heavy but clean. Use keyboard shortcuts (A/R) visual hints (e.g., [A] icon next to Approve button).
portal_3_admin.tables: Do not use traditional table borders. Use pure CSS grid with padding and 1px bottom borders in #222222 to separate rows.

testing.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, navigation links) MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute formatted as kebab-case and role-based (e.g., 'submit-transaction-btn', 'mobile-nav-home').

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard HTML+Tailwind for layout shells, but integrate Shadcn UI primitives for interactives (Select, Dialog, Form, Tabs).
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Use 'Cabinet Grotesk' or 'Manrope' via standard fallback if unavailable, but apply `font-sans` with custom web fonts configured in Tailwind.
Zero gradients everywhere, except the explicit glow shadow on Top 3 Leaderboard items.
PWA manifest configuration should target 'standalone' mode and define #000000 as theme_color and background_color.
For mock data, utilize the provided media URLs heavily. Do not use generic placeholders like via.placeholder.com.
Ensure the Desktop Sidebar is fixed and Mobile Bottom Nav is fixed at bottom (z-50).
